655 IN EFFECT UNTIL 8 AM EDT THIS MORNING FOR THE FOLLOWING AREAS

IN OHIO THIS WATCH INCLUDES 7 COUNTIES

IN NORTH CENTRAL OHIO

CRAWFORD              KNOX                  MARION
MORROW                RICHLAND

HANCOCK               WYANDOT

MOUNT VERNON, AND UPPER SANDUSKY.
